hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook that routes Uniswap v4 swaps through Euler Finance vaults. The beforeSwap handler computes quotes using a proprietary curve invariant, deposits input tokens into and withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults, and returns a custom delta to the PoolManager — bypassing standard concentrated liquidity. Liquidity addition and donations are intentionally blocked.
